runtime.member_contract: Each archive prefix confirms its dated sample directory, but sample 0 does not establish identical member names in the other archives. Under the verified per-sample reads directory require exactly one regular anonymous_reads.fq or anonymous_reads.fq.gz, then validate all interleaved pairs, 150-bp lengths, that sample's anonymous ID prefix and EOF. Never select subsample_0.fq or any arbitrary FASTQ.
runtime.retention: Retain archives, validated FASTQs, C0/CT BAMs and all logs; no automatic deletion. Use explicit shared data-root because measured projected total exceeds the initial Home quota after existing artifacts/environments.
